items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Dip," he says, "a lot of the guys think you would be an asset to the band"

ctx.x: Dip," he says, "a lot of the guys think you would be an asset to the band" and blah-blah-blah-blah.

So I said, "Well, look, I'm headed to New York"... Because my father had been over and told me he thought I should go in to New York and give myself a good chance, and gave me the money to go to New York and everything. So I told Ernie, "Look, I'm headed to New York actually." So he said, "Well, that's perfect, because we're going to Washington, D.C., and you can work your way up with us, and when you get to Washington you can leave and go over to New York, and you'll have more money." Which made good sense, you…
